basic_profile.bio: A seasoned culinary enthusiast hailing from the vibrant city of New York. With a passion for both cooking and exploration, I often find myself delving into the rich flavors of international cuisine, particularly South Asian and Latin American dishes. When I'm not experimenting in the kitchen, I enjoy hiking the trails of upstate New York and immersing myself in true crime podcasts. Currently working as a freelance graphic designer, I have a flexible schedule that allows me to explore my culinary passions and interact with fellow Redditors during late evenings. As a single, adventurous soul, I relish the freedom to travel and experience new cultures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in culinary practices, primarily self-taught through years of experimentation and learning from various cooking shows and online courses. My interest in international cuisines has led me to participate in cooking workshops and cultural exchange programs.
